entries.groundMeasurementMethod: Robust alpha>128 foreground bottom-contour line fit on each ground axis; the 95th-percentile positive residual adds the physical fence post feet below raised rails. Visually checked against the lower post tips or stone-wall base. Side corners are projected foot-line estimates near the outer corner posts, with ±3px painted/post-width uncertainty; the hidden rear corner is not observed. Registration uses opposite-side foot-line midpoint, never silhouette-bottom alignment.

doorMeasurement.notes: Dark personnel entrance; actual same-x vertical opening column. Both selected endpoints are visible; outer trim is excluded.

doorMeasurement.notes: Actual rear courtyard personnel entrance, distinguished from the raised left-annex window chosen automatically at x=990. The nearer green-roof annex obscures the door sill and right leaf. Selected same-x dark visibility is a lower bound; no complete frame height is inferred.

measurementMethod: Independent manual source endpoints and actual fence-post feet. Two-point door endpoints use geometric bottom-top height. Full cutouts partitioned at empty source gutters; one human-calibrated scale per footprint tier, never per-silhouette fit.
